name: Solo Launches

sources.title: Homepage — weekly launch board for solo founders, live 'Launching now' cohort and winners archive
Pricing — Free Launch (queue, top-3 earns dofollow), Premium $9 (guaranteed slot + dofollow), Featured $19/week, Featured+SEO $39

conditions: Free launch is real but queue-limited (up to 5 launches/day) and only earns a dofollow backlink if the product ranks top 3 in its week; $9 Premium guarantees the slot + dofollow regardless of rank
requirements: Aimed at solo founders / indie hackers launching SaaS and indie products
Sign-in required — 'Submit Product' goes through /sign-in to /app/startups/new
Free tier: standard queue (≤5 launches/day), homepage exposure for multiple days
Paid options: Premium $9 one-time (guaranteed next-week slot, dofollow link, 24–48h indexing), Featured $19/week, Featured + SEO Boost $39 one-time (2 lifetime dofollow blog backlinks)
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline, logo, category, description
Optional: decide whether the guaranteed dofollow ($9) is worth skipping the top-3 gamble
workflow: Submit via /app/startups/new (or pick a paid tier from /pricing)
Free submissions enter the standard queue and launch in an upcoming week
During launch week the product appears in 'Launching now' with voting/comments; top 3 get winner badges + dofollow backlinks
Listing persists in the launch archive at /startups/<slug>
watchFor: Dofollow backlink is only guaranteed on the $9 Premium tier — free tier earns it only with a top-3 weekly rank
Content quality varies — the live board includes NSFW/spammy entries (e.g., OnlyFans-adjacent products); brand adjacency is weak
Queue depth unknown — with 5/day cap, free launches may wait
Recurring $19/week Featured is a subscription — cancel anytime
countsAsLive: The product appears under 'Launching now' during its week, then in 'Past launches' with a public /startups/<slug> page
unknowns: Current queue depth / how far out free launches land
How votes are counted and whether they can be gamed
Refund policy specifics for paid tiers (a /refund page exists but wasn't read)
